factor_diagnostics.value_notes: SCDNR describes adult offshore migration in late fall, winter spawning and return to inshore habitat in spring; the Gulf spawning profile describes October-January spawning migration. This supports a broad fall/winter Gulf/Atlantic pattern, but not a South Florida catch curve. The species' reported absence from the Loxahatchee-Caloosahatchee stretch is a major regional applicability caveat for this app. The Florida distribution is discontinuous: Atlantic records extend south to Loxahatchee River, with absence southward and around the peninsula tip, while the Caloosahatchee River Estuary is an exception on the southwest coast. This regional split cannot be represented by the current longitude-only filter.
